methodology: All non-qualitative checks execute the DID resolver and VC stack and record observed outcomes. SSI principles are qualitative and excluded from the score.

checks.requirement: Conformant DIDs (did:method:id) MUST resolve for all 4 implemented methods
checks.notes: resolved 4 conformant DIDs (ethr, nft, key, mobi)

checks.requirement: Malformed DID (no 'did:' scheme) MUST produce a resolution error, not a document
checks.notes: 'not-a-did' rejected with error='internalError', didDocument=null

checks.requirement: Unsupported DID method MUST yield a resolution error ('methodNotSupported')
checks.notes: error surfaced (resolution safely refused) but code is 'internalError' instead of 'methodNotSupported'

checks.requirement: Method-specific identifier violating the method's ABNF (did:nft w/o tokenId) MUST error
checks.notes: did:nft without tokenId rejected with error='internalError'

checks.requirement: DID document MUST contain 'id' equal to the DID that was resolved
checks.notes: all 4 documents carry id equal to the resolved DID

checks.requirement: JSON-LD DID document MUST include the DID Core @context
checks.notes: all 4 documents include 'https://www.w3.org/ns/did/v1'

checks.requirement: 'controller', when present, MUST be a valid DID
checks.notes: did:ethr controller = did:ethr:0x1:0xab12ab12ab12ab12ab12ab12ab12ab12ab12ab12

checks.requirement: Verification methods MUST have 'id', 'type' and 'controller'
checks.notes: id/type/controller present on every verification method (4 methods)

checks.requirement: Verification methods MUST carry public key material
checks.notes: key material present for all methods, but ['mobi'] carry the placeholder '0x...' instead of a real key (registry lookup not implemented)

checks.requirement: 'authentication' references MUST resolve to verification methods in the document
checks.notes: authentication references resolve to in-document methods (4 methods)

checks.requirement: 'assertionMethod', when present, MUST reference in-document verification methods
checks.notes: valid assertionMethod on ['ethr', 'key'] (property is optional for the others)

checks.requirement: Services MUST have 'id', 'type' and 'serviceEndpoint'
checks.notes: did:nft and did:mobi services all carry id/type/serviceEndpoint

checks.requirement: Resolution MUST return DID resolution metadata (contentType, retrieved)
checks.notes: contentType + parseable 'retrieved' timestamp on all resolutions

checks.requirement: Resolution SHOULD return DID document metadata ('created')
checks.notes: documentMetadata.created present and ISO-8601 parseable

checks.requirement: DID URL fragment MUST dereference to a resource inside the DID document
checks.notes: 'did:ethr:0x1:0xab12ab12ab12ab12ab12ab12ab12ab12ab12ab12#controller' dereferences to a verification method

checks.requirement: @context MUST be present with the base v2 context first
checks.notes: @context[0] == 'https://www.w3.org/ns/credentials/v2' on a freshly issued VC

checks.requirement: Credential 'id', when present, MUST be a URL/URI
checks.notes: credential id is a URI: urn:uuid:c172c541-41ac-48ce-85dc-700f42f7fc80

checks.requirement: 'type' MUST include 'VerifiableCredential' plus a specific type
checks.notes: type = ['VerifiableCredential', 'VehicleBirthCertificate']

checks.requirement: 'issuer' MUST be present and be a URI (DID) identifying the issuer
checks.notes: issuer = did:ethr:0x1:0x6F9e4A189f83e614BFD94a213FF56DC5a679B6ff

checks.requirement: 'credentialSubject' MUST be present with claims about the subject
checks.notes: subject id = holder DID, 6 claims carried

checks.requirement: 'validFrom'/'validUntil' MUST be valid XML-Schema dateTime values (v2 renames issuanceDate)
checks.notes: validFrom=2026-07-23T22:51:29Z, validUntil=2027-07-23T22:51:29Z, both XML-Schema dateTime

checks.requirement: 'credentialSchema', when present, MUST have 'id' and 'type'
checks.notes: credentialSchema: type=JsonSchema, id=https://cvin.ubc.ca/credentials/automotive/v1/schemas/VehicleBirthCertificate

checks.requirement: 'credentialStatus', when present, MUST have 'id' and 'type'
checks.notes: credentialStatus: type=CvinRevocationRegistry2024

checks.requirement: Credential MUST carry a DataIntegrityProof with all required proof properties
checks.notes: DataIntegrityProof with cryptosuite/created/verificationMethod/proofPurpose=assertionMethod/proofValue

checks.requirement: Proof MUST be cryptographically bound to the issuer's key (recoverable signature)
checks.notes: secp256k1 recovery yields the issuer address 0x6F9e4A189f83e614BFD94a213FF56DC5a679B6ff (offline, no chain round-trip)

checks.requirement: A well-formed, freshly issued credential MUST verify end-to-end
checks.notes: verify_credential => valid, sub-checks ['disclosure', 'revocation', 'schema', 'signature', 'structure', 'temporal'] all true (0.35 ms)

checks.requirement: NEGATIVE: credential missing a required property MUST be rejected
checks.notes: credential stripped of 'issuer' rejected by structure check

checks.requirement: NEGATIVE: tampering with a signed claim MUST invalidate the proof
checks.notes: claim edit ('make': Tesla→Lada) breaks signature recovery

checks.requirement: NEGATIVE: credential forged under another issuer's DID MUST be rejected
checks.notes: recovered signer != address embedded in the claimed issuer DID → rejected

checks.requirement: NEGATIVE: credential past 'validUntil' MUST be rejected
checks.notes: validUntil in the past → temporal check rejects

checks.requirement: NEGATIVE: revoked credential MUST fail status checking
checks.notes: valid before revocation, rejected after RevocationRegistry.revoke()

checks.requirement: NEGATIVE: claims violating the declared schema MUST be refused at issuance
checks.notes: issuance refused: claims failed schema validation for VehicleBirthCertificate: missing required property 'model'; missing required property 'year'; missing required property 'manufacturingDate'; missing required property 'manufacturerDid'; property 'vin' failed validation: 'BAD'

checks.requirement: VP MUST have '@context', 'type' incl. VerifiablePresentation, 'holder' and credentials
checks.notes: @context/type/holder/verifiableCredential all present

checks.requirement: VP proof MUST bind challenge + domain with proofPurpose 'authentication'
checks.notes: holder-signed proof with proofPurpose=authentication, challenge and domain bound

checks.requirement: A holder-signed VP MUST verify, including every embedded credential
checks.notes: VP and embedded credential verify against the expected challenge/domain

checks.requirement: NEGATIVE: replayed VP (stale challenge) MUST be rejected
checks.notes: same VP replayed under a new challenge → rejected

checks.requirement: NEGATIVE: VP bound to another domain/audience MUST be rejected
checks.notes: VP presented to a different domain → rejected

checks.requirement: NEGATIVE: presentation by a non-holder (stolen credential) MUST be rejected
checks.notes: VP signed with a non-holder key over a stolen credential → rejected

checks.requirement: NEGATIVE: wallet MUST refuse presentation creation without a challenge
checks.notes: wallet refuses to create a VP without a challenge

checks.requirement: SD credential MUST carry salted claim digests, not raw claim values
checks.notes: signed VC carries 7 salted digests; raw values stay with the holder

checks.requirement: Partial disclosure MUST verify while hidden claims remain hidden
checks.notes: disclosed {vin, odometerKm} verified against signed digests; cost/technicianId values never leave the wallet

checks.requirement: NEGATIVE: tampering with a disclosed value MUST break the digest check
checks.notes: odometer 42150→9000 after signing → digest mismatch → rejected

checks.requirement: Data Integrity proofs SHOULD use a standard canonicalization (RDFC-1.0)
checks.notes: DOCUMENTED DEVIATION: proofs are computed over deterministic (sorted-key) JSON, not URDNA2015/RDFC-1.0 RDF dataset canonicalization required by registered Data Integrity cryptosuites

checks.requirement: Proof cryptosuite SHOULD be a W3C-registered Data Integrity cryptosuite
checks.notes: DOCUMENTED DEVIATION: cryptosuite 'eip191-secp256k1-recovery-2024' is thesis-defined (EIP-191 + secp256k1 recovery), not in the W3C Data Integrity cryptosuite registry ['bbs-2023', 'ecdsa-jcs-2019', 'ecdsa-rdfc-2019', 'ecdsa-sd-2023', 'eddsa-jcs-2022', 'eddsa-rdfc-2022']

checks.requirement: User Control: holder controls keys and credentials
checks.notes: assessed qualitatively — holder wallet holds its own secp256k1 key; presentations are holder-signed

checks.requirement: Consent: data sharing requires an explicit holder action
checks.notes: assessed qualitatively — credentials leave the wallet only via create_presentation()

checks.requirement: Portability: identity is expressed in standard formats
checks.notes: assessed qualitatively — W3C DIDs and VC DM 2.0 JSON documents

checks.requirement: Interoperability: follows open W3C specifications
checks.notes: assessed qualitatively — subject to the deviations counted as FAIL above

checks.requirement: Privacy by design: minimal data exposure
checks.notes: assessed qualitatively — selective disclosure via salted digests, demonstrated above

checks.requirement: Decentralization: no mandatory central verifier
checks.notes: assessed qualitatively — offline verification via signature recovery; no chain round-trip

checks.requirement: Transparency: open standards and auditable design
checks.notes: assessed qualitatively — spec-referenced checks in this file exercise the public API

checks.requirement: Minimal disclosure: share only what is required
checks.notes: assessed qualitatively — hidden claims travel as digests only, demonstrated above

checks.requirement: Security: cryptographic protection
checks.notes: assessed qualitatively — secp256k1 signatures; forgery/tamper/replay rejections demonstrated above

checks.requirement: Persistence: identifiers are long-lived
checks.notes: assessed qualitatively — DIDs derived from keys / VIN / on-chain identity
